messages:
maria: Quick thread — putting together a compact 'launch snackpack' for the go-live. Goal: one-liners for Hosted, Dedicated, Private; 3 short launch social posts; a webinar hook; and inbound routing rules. Targeting devs + platform leads. :rocket:
sam: Love it. Timeline suggestion: social day 0, webinar week 1, targeted emails to trials on day 3. Which KPIs do we want to call out? impressions/registrations/leads? :eyes:
devin: I'll drop 1-line value props and 2 CTA variants per mode. Keep tone concise and engineering-forward. Drafts below:

Hosted — "Production-grade inference, zero ops — start in minutes." CTAs: "Try hosted API" / "See latency benchmarks"
Dedicated — "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput and SLAs." CTAs: "Request capacity" / "See pricing & SLOs"
Private — "Bring Redwood into your VPC or on‑prem for full control." CTAs: "Contact sales" / "Download compliance brief"

jules: For the landing modules: keep hero lines to one sentence + microcopy under the CTA explaining next step (signup vs. book vs. contact). Use the same visual frame for all three so comparison tests are clean. Also: add a tiny trust row with "SLA / KMS / VPC" icons. :zap:
kevin: Routing snippet for inbound (simple YAML sample for engineers handing to infra):

```yaml
inbound_routes:
  - mode: hosted
    path: /signup
    utm: campaign=launch_hosted
    funnel: self_serve_onboard
  - mode: dedicated
    path: /contact/sales
    utm: campaign=launch_dedicated
    funnel: capacity_commit
  - mode: private
    path: /contact/enterprise
    utm: campaign=launch_private
    funnel: sales_assisted
```

kevin: KPIs: track utm_source, utm_campaign, landing variant, signups -> trial conversion rate, demo requests, MQLs. We should set up a dashboard for day 0/day 7 conversions.
maria: Webinar hook (30‑min): "Serving LLMs in production: tradeoffs and real numbers" — 3 panels: latency & cost, rollouts & reliability, security & private deploys. CTA: register -> asks for mode preference (hosted/dedicated/private) so we can route.
sam: Social post examples (short):
- Post A: "New from Redwood: pick the inference deployment that fits your SLA and budget — Hosted, Dedicated, or Private. Live demo + benchmarks next week. Register: <short link>"
- Post B: "Why serving matters more than owning — join our webinar for real-world latency & cost numbers. Seats limited. <short link>"
- Post C: "Ship LLM features with predictable cost & latency — see a 30-minute walkthrough. <short link>"

devin: A/B test idea: hero CTA text (Try hosted API vs See latency benchmarks) for pages with developer intent. For sales-intent audiences (paid ads/enterprise lists) use Book a demo vs Contact sales.
jules: Visual note: for the three mode cards, alternate the background tint and surface elevation so that Dedicated visually feels "solid" and Private feels "shielded"; avoid changing CTA placement.
maria: Can each of you update the shared doc by EOD with copy + one image suggestion? I'll assemble the snackpack (3 landing variants, 3 social posts, webinar page, and the routing YAML) and ping infra to wire the UTMs. Launch-bot: schedule initial announcement for 09:00 PT on the 21st?
launch-bot: scheduled announcement for 2026-04-21 09:00 PT (channel: #general). :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks — once doc is updated I'll do a final scrub and loop in sales for the Private pitch flow. Anything else?
sam: Can we include a short benchmark blurb on each landing card: "median p50 latency on A100 — 80ms" or similar? We can swap numbers per model, but a single representative stat helps.
devin: Agreed — I'll add a short benchmark sentence that references the model family and sequence length.
maria: Perfect. Wrapping up — I'll post the assembled snackpack here tomorrow morning for quick approvals. :thumbsup:
